text:
**Review Result**

Quality score: **5/10**. The code is readable and reasonably scoped for a research demo, but I would not approve it as-is. The biggest problem is reproducibility: the documented/default pipeline depends on `data/stories`, but this checkout has no story dataset, and the story-generation command itself cannot bootstrap from an empty directory.

I could not run the test suite because declared dependencies are not installed in the container (`numpy`, `PyYAML`, etc.). Syntax compilation passed when bytecode output was redirected to `/tmp`.

**Concrete Issues**

| Severity | Location | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| high | `config.yaml:11-14`, `emovec/stories.py:72-82` | Default extraction points at `data/stories`, but this checkout has no story files, so `make demo`/`emovec extract --tiny` fail from a clean tree. |
| high | `emovec/cli.py:54-58`, `emovec/stories.py:58-60` | `generate-stories` requires an existing `manifest.json` before it can generate stories, contradicting the README bootstrap flow. |
| high | `emovec/model.py:123-125` | Empty or one-token inputs can produce division by zero or all-zero activations in `mean_activations`. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py:168-180` | `all_token_activations` materializes all layers/tokens as float32 at once, creating large memory spikes for default batches. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py:268` | `choice_logits` forces batch size to at least 8, ignoring user memory tuning via `--batch-size`. |
| medium | `emovec/stories.py:122-137` | External story-generation requests have no timeout, retry, or response validation, so runs can hang or fail unclearly. |
| medium | `emovec/stories.py:118-145`, `emovec/steer.py:139` | Emotion labels are used directly in filesystem paths and output filenames without sanitization. |
| medium | `emovec/vectors.py:37-40` | Missing labels for an emotion produce NaN vectors instead of a clear validation error. |
| medium | `emovec/vectors.py:66-70` | PCA on zero-variance activations can divide by zero and propagate NaNs. |
| medium | `emovec/extract.py:99-110` | Loaded vector artifacts are not validated against the active config, so stale outputs can silently drive validation/steering. |
| medium | `emovec/steer.py:107-110` | `n_steered_emotions` is not bounded by available emotions and can select duplicates. |
| medium | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:18-24` | Integration test assumes a gated external model and local story data without preflight skips or fixtures. |
| medium | `tests/test_datasets.py:44-51` | Story dataset validation is skipped when the dataset is absent, masking the clean-checkout failure. |
| low | `.gitignore:1-3`, `emovec.egg-info/SOURCES.txt:17-22` | Ignored generated artifacts (`outputs/`, `*.egg-info`) are present in the workspace snapshot and should be cleaned from source control/artifacts. |

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **280 LOC**.

Bottom line: **No, I would not approve this PR as-is.**
